sourceIdentityNote: Early sourceSha values are declared launch checkouts. Updated launchers derive sourceSha from the DLL informational version, so later tests identify the compiled commit even when the checkout advances. Every stage retains its own actual loaded DLL hash.
limits: Natural runs use a deterministic pilot, one seed per branch/class/tier, first legal map path, basic potion/choice policies and no purposeful shop/upgrade solver. They end in natural deaths; these are not human or campaign win-rate estimates.

Pressure trials add four fixed archetype cards and force Nibbits Normal. Risk cohorts additionally inject Family Seal. They have ordinary HP/Energy, but are controlled fights rather than natural reward acquisition.

Early stages use distinct diagnostic DLLs. The first pressure driver completed Knight/Mage then failed on the test label vegan instead of canonical nomeat. Its duplicate early Ranger rows are excluded; Ranger was rerun in fresh profiles.

The one-card Battle Meditation adjustment follows the initial pressure/campaign measurements. Their original hashes/budgets remain historical observations, not claims of campaigns with the final draw change.

A first ordinary-fuel loop assumption did not sustain; Reflex was required. Two recovery probes copied the prior DLL before compilation finished, answered unknown-command and are excluded. No timed-out mutation was replayed.
An initial co-op draw driver selected a stale visual holder after skipVisuals reset. Verified stages require current Hand membership and a newly opened choice task; failed co-op rows are excluded.
Physical Steam Deck/Linux and Steam transport remain #110 gaps. Higher-Ascension/full-winning multi-seed archetype campaigns and long-term purchase trajectories are tracked in #146.
